w: Swamishri celebrated the birthday of Jaga Swami - a staunch disciple of Gunatitanand Swami.

When Swamishri was asked to write the essence of Vachanamrutam on a large sized replica of the Vachanamrutam, he wrote, "To realise Ekantik dharma, become brahmaroop and offer bhakti to Shriji Maharaj."
At 6.30 pm Swamishri arrived at the Haveli hall and performed Sharda pujan by showering flowers, kumkum and rice grains on account books.
Mr. Jim Zay, member of DuPage County Board, presented a proclamation to Swamishri and declared 20 October 2000 as Pramukh Swami Day.
The kishores of Chicago performed a beautiful 'Deep Nrutya' and pleased Swamishri.

Swamishri performed mangala arti in Akshar Deri. After performing his puja, Swamishri performed arti of the New Year's mahapuja and blessed the assembly for the New Year by explaining Vachanamrut Sarangpur - 7.
At 10.45 a.m. Swamishri blessed the morning assembly. Thereafter Swamishri went to Thakorji and devotionally sang the thals during the annakut offering of 550 food items. ( See News report )
In the evening satsang assembly, the vice-president of Kenya, Moody Awori, came to meet Swamishri.

Ketan Chhipwadiya had come from San Francisco for darshan. He had gone to Iraq for the war. He stayed there for about a year and a half, but remained completely vegetarian. Now he works at NASA and is making good progress. Seeing such firmness in his disciplines and dharma, Pramukh Swami Maharaj expressed his pleasure.

In today's evening assembly, Mahant Swami Maharaj watched the skit "Satsang ka Suraj" (the sun of satsang), showing what a sorry state results when one lacks knowledge of satsang. Then, giving blessings, he said:

"What a muddle! If we don't know, we should keep quiet. This satsang is so pure and holy. In the whole world there is nothing as great as satsang. A college is where knowledge is given and students receive it. It is a matter of removing the laxity, laziness and carelessness that remain in the Satsang Shikshan Pariksha (satsang examinations). And what is the Satsang Shikshan Pariksha? If one reads for 15 days, one will know it, but this knowledge is of no use in a job or in worldly dealings, so people don't prepare. But Shriji Maharaj is pleased.

"What incidents there are in these books! Reading one incident gives you goosebumps. Shriji Maharaj says, 'If one does even an atom's worth for satsang, God does not forget it and considers it as large as Mount Meru!' Where else can you find this? So the decision (will be made) in a single birth. This is a sure thing, on a firm foundation. So keep faith in it.

"Why should we not trust God and the Sant? People lie for wealth, women and fame, but God and the Sant have none of these three. So if we trust, all the work is done. What must we do before becoming brahmarup? Trust. Satsang is not attained with a little merit. Even if a little merit is lacking, it is not attained. We have done everything. Only this one matter of ekantik dharma remains. So with trust, do seva and devotion along with dharma. Then the work is done."
During Mahant Swami Maharaj's meal, as decided according to the doctors' advice, soft music was played.
Aksharjivandas Swami expressed a curiosity that arose in his mind: "Akshardham must be just like this, mustn't it! Sweet music playing and having darshan of Maharaj!!"
Swamishri said, "Only darshan. No speaking at all... Ten million times more satisfaction comes from darshan than the satisfaction one feels when some great work is done."
Only "the beloved dweller of Akshar" can give such a description.
